scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w rewear-api" "npm run dev -w rewear-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w rewear-web && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w rewear-web && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run seed -w rewear-api
